name: Noordhoek Aeroplane Mode 2025

venue.name: Noordhoek Community Center
venue.address: Avondrust Cir, Chapmans Peak, Cape Town, 7979

information: **INFORMATION** CubingZA is very happy to announce Noordhoek Aeroplane Mode 2025! This will be a PBQ-style competition with all the blindfolded events. Please see the events tab for more information. Don't forget that to participate you need to register for the competition in the "Register" tab, and make payment by buying a ticket. Please see Registration Requirements below. **MYSTERY PRIZES** There will be some fun prizes up for grabs at this competition so make sure to stick around until the awards!
